data.text: Before we choose, can we agree on limits that keep the lake productive? I propose 18 tons each this month: that earns each of us $18,000 and leaves 10 tons. Next month’s stock would be 100 tons with 75% probability or 20 tons otherwise—not a guaranteed refill. If it’s 20, we could each take 3 tons, leaving the minimum 5 alive. Let’s agree to adjust our whole-ton limits to the actual stock each month and review everyone’s catches afterward. Taking extra now risks destroying income for all of us, including whoever takes it. John, would you support that?
